fixed.member: style pack rules on documents defined later
fixed.summary: A document defined after the style pack is set takes the pack's element rules and `::part` host rules, as one defined before it does, and a document that carries a pack's rules sheds them when it is defined after the pack is cleared. Before, `Ui::define_document` kept whatever sheet the document was parsed against, so a document loaded after `set_style_pack` showed the default style's element rules until the pack was set again.
